Cleaner file management: deleting really deletes, and saved files can move with you.

## What's new

- **Clear All asks first.** Clearing History now asks whether to delete the files too or keep them and only clear the list. You can undo for a few seconds.
- **Swipe to delete.** Swiping a file in History deletes it from storage, not just from the list. You can undo for a few seconds.
- **Move your saved files.** When you change the save folder in Settings, you're offered the choice to move your existing files there too. History keeps working either way. You can also keep them where they are.
- **Moves are safe.** A move can be stopped part way. Files already moved stay in the new place, and the rest stay where they were. If a file can't be moved, the result says which ones stayed behind.
- **Clear direction on the move screen.** The progress track shows which way the files are going.

## Fixes

- Clearing History and saving again no longer names the new file "App_v1 (1).apk". Old copies are removed from storage, so the name is free.
- Deleted files no longer stay in your save folder after you clear History.
- Files in a folder you picked can be deleted and moved like files in the default folder.

## Also in this release

Includes the XAPK install support from 1.7.0 and the install-details fixes.

## Download

Get **`apk-extractor-v1.8.0.apk`**. Requires Android 7.0 or newer. It updates earlier versions in place, keeping your settings and history. Android may offer to scan the app before installing, because it doesn't come from the Play Store. Tap "Scan app" and it will install normally.
